title: Reliability and Limitations of Interspecies Aquatic Toxicity Extrapolation: Evidence from Inpyrfluxam and Other Succinate Dehydrogenase Inhibitor Fungicides
status: Rules frozen before Phase1E strategy outcomes; Phase1D outcomes already seen; exploratory comparison, not preregistration
eligible: Species-level models; exact positive surrogate endpoint; inside numerical input domain; MSE<0.95,R2>0.6,slope0.6-1.4,official95%meanCIwidth<=100-fold. No failed-model fallback.
A_quality: Among eligible: smallest MSE; ties highest R2,largest training n,scientific surrogate name
B_domain: Among eligible: smallest training-only leverage h=1/n+(log10input-xmean)^2/Sxx; ties smallest MSE,scientific name. No hyperparameter tuning.
C_geomean: Equal mean of eligible log10 predictions; even singleton allowed but flagged; no ensemble PI claimed
C_median: Median of eligible log10 predictions; singleton flagged; no fitted weights
D_rainbow: Available frozen model with Oncorhynchus mykiss; no self prediction; report quality/domain rather than assume optimal
D_zebrafish: Available frozen model with Danio rerio; no self prediction; report quality/domain
sensitivity: Alternative HSE focal endpoints; stricter MSE<=0.5 and n>=10; C at least two eligible surrogates; same target comparisons; leave-one-compound-out descriptive summaries for trout direction
independence: 2 external candidates, no detected overlap public paired training; original full database independence not fully verified. 6 conditional compound-held-out internal sensitivity; published model topology and public preprocessing retained, so not strict nested model-development validation.
